description: A parameter is suspected to be passed unsanitized into a shell command; a conditional OS-level delay primitive is used to confirm execution without needing visible output.
detection_method: Significant timing delta vs. baseline (comparison.py timing_significant), corroborated by a second differently-sized delay to rule out jitter.

description: Command chaining/substitution metacharacters appended to a parameter that is suspected to reach a shell, looking for OS command output reflected back in the response.
detection_method: Response body contains recognizable OS command output patterns not present in baseline (e.g. a process listing or version banner format).

description: A parameter that accepts a URL (webhook, import-from-URL, PDF renderer, image proxy) is pointed at an internal-only address (loopback, link-local metadata endpoint, RFC1918 range) to test whether the server fetches it server-side.
detection_method: Out-of-band callback confirmation (DNS/HTTP interactsh-style canary) is the reliable signal; in-band detection via distinct status/timing/error differences vs. a public-URL baseline is a weaker secondary signal requiring corroboration.

description: A file-path parameter is tested with relative traversal sequences to see whether the application resolves paths outside its intended directory and discloses local file contents.
detection_method: Response body matches a known OS file-content signature (e.g. a standard system file's first-line format) not present in baseline, combined with a 200 status.

description: A file-path parameter used for writing, archiving, or extracting (e.g. a zip-extract destination, a log-file-name parameter) is tested with relative traversal sequences to see whether it can write outside the intended directory -- distinct from LFI's read-only disclosure case.
detection_method: A follow-up read of a known, predictable location outside the intended directory (one the tester controls, e.g. a path under their own authorized upload area) confirms the written file landed outside the sandbox.

description: A file-include parameter is pointed at an attacker-controlled remote URL to test whether the application fetches and executes/includes remote content server-side.
detection_method: Out-of-band callback to a controlled listener is the only reliable confirmation; requires an explicitly authorized external listener under the assessment's scope.

description: A state-changing request (POST/PUT/DELETE) is checked for the absence of an anti-CSRF token, a SameSite cookie attribute, or Origin/Referer validation.
detection_method: Static analysis of the request/response pair: no csrf-token-shaped hidden field or header present, cookie Set-Cookie lacks SameSite=Strict/Lax, and the action succeeds without an Origin header matching the site.

description: An XML parameter/upload is tested for whether the parser resolves externally-defined entities, which can lead to local file disclosure or SSRF via an out-of-band callback.
detection_method: Out-of-band callback confirmation preferred; in-band file-content disclosure in the response is a secondary signal, both requiring explicit authorization given potential for SSRF side effects.

description: User input is suspected to be rendered through a server-side template engine; a harmless arithmetic template expression is submitted to check whether it is evaluated rather than printed literally.
detection_method: Response contains the evaluated numeric result of the expression rather than the literal input string -- a clean, unambiguous positive signal with very low false-positive risk.
